# ThreadSanitizer suppressions file

# Signals dynamically loaded from UI library at the start
race:InterfaceThread
race:SignalInterfaceShouldClose
race:SignalLogUpdate
race:SignalCameraRefresh
race:SignalPipelineUpdate
race:SignalObservationReset
race:SignalServerEvent
race:SignalCameraInteraction

# Global state, members individually secured
race:StateInstance
race:InterfaceInstance

# Async target detection is designed to be racy
# FrameRecord::trackers (pushes back a new one in pre-allocated vector storage)
race:detectTargetAsync

# False positive, finishedProcessing is written once, then read only
race:FrameRecord::finishedProcessing

# For documentation, see https://github.com/google/sanitizers/wiki/FrameRecord::ThreadSanitizerSuppressions
